title: Orange Yoga Studio
bottom_line: Financial analysis reveals Orange Yoga is operating at a monthly loss of approximately $1,650. Monthly revenue is $12,864 (from $12 per-class fees with 8 students on weekdays and 6 on weekends), while monthly costs total $14,450 (including $3,500 rent, $150 insurance, $3,200 administration, $7,100 instructor salaries, and $500 loan payments). The profit decline resulted from a $2,000 monthly rent increase and $10 per-class salary increase for instructors.
